findings.title: Auto-routers cannot be selected
findings.problem: The backend's LiteLLM auto-router option omits status and enabled, but adminModels maps both directly. ModelActions requires model.enabled and status === enabled, so the Set as global default action is never offered for those entries.
findings.impact: The admin UI cannot select a LiteLLM auto-router despite the approved requirement allowing selectable auto-routers.
findings.recommendation: Normalize selectable auto-router status and availability from the router response or provide those fields in the API, then use that state to gate the action.

findings.title: User model catalog stays stale
findings.problem: setGlobalDefault and clearGlobalDefault refresh only adminModelsStore. The already loaded appInfoStore.llmModels and llmRouters retain their prior isDefault values; consumers read those values for selection.
findings.impact: A mounted consumer may continue showing or selecting the previous default until another model fetch occurs; reachability across navigation and mounted views is not fully confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Refresh the user model catalog after a successful set or clear, or invalidate it so every default consumer refetches.

findings.title: Status change leaves global label stale
findings.problem: handleStatusChange calls setModelStatus and fetchGlobalDefault, but never refetches catalog rows. setModelStatus patches status only; defaultForCategories is mapped only by indexModels.
findings.impact: After disabling or deprecating an effective default, the summary can show the fallback while the table still labels the old model global.
findings.recommendation: Refetch the catalog after a successful status update so Default for reflects the backend's effective assignment.

findings.title: Orphaned choice cannot be cleared
findings.problem: Clear global default is rendered only in a model-row action. When the saved model is removed from a refreshed catalog, no row has that base name, although the saved name remains in the summary.
findings.impact: Admins cannot clear an unavailable saved choice from the Model management page, leaving the temporary fallback as the only effective value.
findings.recommendation: Render a Clear global default control beside the saved-choice summary whenever saved_base_name is present, independently of catalog rows.
